snippet.title: Grobnopolis: Last Days | Play Demo | CRTime
snippet.description:
It’s 1983. The residents of the mining town Huta-Grobno haven’t seen the sun for months. A thick grey blanket of cloud keeps the city under perpetual gloom, and now the authorities have identified something unusual in the mines.

And it’s moving…

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851090/Grobnopolis__Last_Days/

Coming soon to XBOX on PC.
